terms.definition: The record an electronic lock keeps of every credential that opened it and when, downloaded with a programmer. The first objective evidence in a room entry or theft case.
The signed, unbroken record of who held an item of evidence, when, and what they did with it, from collection to court. A gap lets anyone say the evidence was changed.
The Veldane LP stance: officers observe, report and de-escalate. Physical intervention, searches and detention happen only as policy and local law allow.
A question that invites an account ("walk me through...") rather than a yes or no. It gets more information and does not suggest the answer.
Saying or implying the hotel is at fault or will pay. Liability is decided by claims, insurers and counsel on the facts, never on the floor.
Matching a person to the room registration (photo ID, name, registration details) before issuing a key, opening a door or confirming a guest is staying.
Lowering tension with calm voice, open body language, listening, clear requests and options, so a conflict ends without force.
